findings.title: Recovery codes remain reusable after successful authentication
findings.body: This user-storage validator only checks whether the submitted code is present; it never removes or marks the code as used. Since recovery-code validation is delegated to the storage provider, the same code can authenticate repeatedly, violating the one-time-use security property of recovery codes. Update the stored code set on successful validation and add a test that rejects a code on its second use.
